name: verify_accountAccountTag_audit_columns_by_id
note: account_account_tag: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM account_account_tag ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountAccountTag_scalar_listing
note: account_account_tag: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, color, country_id, applicability, active FROM account_account_tag ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountAccountTag_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: account_account_tag: per-parent count of each embedded array (account_account_tag_account_move_line_rel, account_account_tag_account_tax_repartition_line_rel, account_account_tag_product_template_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_accountmovelinerel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_accounttaxrepartitionlinerel, COALESCE(e2.n, 0) AS n_producttemplaterel FROM account_account_tag r LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_account_tag_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_tag_account_move_line_rel GROUP BY account_account_tag_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_account_tag_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_tag_account_tax_repartition_line_rel GROUP BY account_account_tag_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_account_tag_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_tag_product_template_rel GROUP BY account_account_tag_id) e2 ON e2.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
